hebrewText: וְ/נִגַּ֣שׂ הָ/עָ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ יִרְהֲב֗וּ הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ בַּ/זָּקֵ֔ן וְ/הַ/נִּקְלֶ֖ה בַּ/נִּכְבָּֽד

tokens.bdb: to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize
tokens.kjv: distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), [idiom] raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.kjv: brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, [idiom] (an-) other.

tokens.bdb: to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently
tokens.kjv: overcome, behave self proudly, make sure, strengthen.

tokens.bdb: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)
tokens.kjv: babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).
aged, ancient (man), elder(-est), old (man, men and...women), senator.

tokens.bdb: to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt)
tokens.kjv: base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.

tokens.bdb: to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses)
tokens.kjv: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, [idiom] be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, [idiom] more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.
